column1: # /Graph Options Legend Range — populate the six legend slots from
# the cell text of a worksheet range.
# Slice F (legend range) of GRAPH_PLAN.md. Until this slice the
# Range leaf was a NotImplemented stub; the per-letter A..F leaves
# took text prompts one at a time. After: a POINT prompt opens; on
# commit the cells in the selected range fill legends[0..6] in
# order. Cell text uses the same display contract as the pie wedge
# labels (Text → as-is, Number → stringified, Empty/Error → empty).
# Legends A..D filled from the cells; E/F still unset.
